description_en: Queries the details of a specific feature instance in a specified workspace
description_zh: 查询指定工作空间中特定功能实例的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun searchplat get-function-instance --workspace-name default --function-name nl2sql --instance-name test --biz-output normal --api-version 2024-04-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetFunctionInstance

parameters.help_en:
The service type. Valid values:
- nl2sql: NL2SQL model type.
- embedding-tuning: Embedding tuning.
- deployment: Custom model deployment.
- notebook: Service development notebook
parameters.help_zh: 服务类型nl2sql模型类型embedding-tuning自定义模型部署deployment服务开发notebook
parameters.name: function_name

parameters.help_en: The configuration name, model name, custom model deployment configuration name, or notebook instance name
parameters.help_zh: 配置/模型/自定义模型部署配置名称/notebook实例名称
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
Controls the richness of the returned information. Valid values:
- simple: displays only basic information.
- normal: displays information such as createParameters and cron. This is the default value.
- detail: returns training task information
parameters.help_zh:
控制返回信息的丰富度
- simple：只显示基本信息
- normal：显示createParameters, cron等信息（默认）
- detail: 返回训练任务信息
parameters.name: output
